scope: Read-only CodeArts installation inspection and one isolated no-tool model probe. No credential values, private hostnames, usernames, or account identifiers are recorded.

installation.desktop_launcher_kind: Terminal running the CodeArts CLI; it is not evidence of an installed graphical IDE.

cli_features_observed_in_help.reasoning_caution: --thinking displays thinking blocks; it does not establish that a model supports reasoning control. --variant is provider-specific.

checks.name: minimal_real_model_request
checks.requested_behavior: Reply with one marker; do not use tools or read/write files.
checks.diagnostic: Authentication failed: CODEARTS_CLI_AK/CODEARTS_CLI_SK environment variables are not set.
checks.interpretation: Exit code zero must not be treated as model success. Existing CLI OAuth state did not authorize this non-interactive invocation.

checks.name: agent_list_mcp_list_models
checks.diagnostic: The same missing-AK/SK check prevented these native CLI commands.

checks.name: graphical_ide_native_extension
checks.reason: No graphical IDE installation or codearts-data directory was found in the checked locations.

checks.name: reasoning_streaming_image_file_matrix
checks.reason: The baseline model request is blocked by authentication. Help flags alone do not verify model capabilities.

cli_mcp.configuration: ~/.codeartsdoer/codearts_cli.json or codearts_cli.jsonc; project equivalents are supported

ide_mcp.configuration: The IDE-managed mcp_settings.json; resolve the real path before writing

cli_hooks.contract: Export a plugin function returning supported lifecycle hooks. This is different from a VS Code extension.
